payload.description: Track UX and platform hardening requested after live testing: spinner semantics, guide zoom, programme detail scroll, clearer rerun semantics, background/PiP playback, and Apple ecosystem transport controls.
payload.title: Playback polish and cross-device controls

payload.description: Implement two-finger pinch on guide grid to change horizontal time scale (minutes per screen) while preserving current center time. Support landscape use where users want finer granularity.
payload.title: Guide: add pinch zoom for time scale

payload.description: Fix programme detail modal so long metadata/description content can always scroll on iOS and Android without gesture conflicts. Ensure backdrop-tap-to-close still works.
payload.title: Programme modal: make long descriptions reliably scrollable

payload.description: Audit XMLTV <previously-shown> mapping and replace 'Rerun' badge copy with clearer user-facing language (e.g., 'Previously Aired'). Optionally add brief tooltip/help text.
payload.title: Programme badges: clarify rerun semantics

payload.description: Add production-grade background playback behavior: continue audio when app backgrounds, support PiP where available, and expose lock-screen transport controls with now-playing metadata.
payload.title: Enable background playback + PiP + lock-screen transport controls

payload.description: Determine scope and implementation path for Apple TV remote integration and Apple Watch transport controls; identify minimum viable support in React Native/Expo dev build pipeline.
payload.title: Apple TV/watch control surface feasibility + implementation plan

payload.description: Spinner overlay currently appears during transient buffering callbacks even while video is progressing. Use stall-aware logic and progress signals to avoid false-positive spinner states.
payload.title: Player spinner should reflect true playback stalls

payload.body: Implemented in app/player.tsx: added stall-aware buffering overlay (delay + progress heartbeat), removed false-positive onStopped buffering trigger, and increased VLC network cache. Typecheck/tests pass.

payload.description: In full-screen player, the bottom overlay keeps showing the programme from when channel playback started. It should refresh now-playing/description/progress as time advances and roll over when programme changes.
payload.title: Player overlay now-playing should roll over at programme boundaries

payload.body: Patched app/player.tsx to add a periodic clock tick (15s) and pass explicit now to getNowPlaying so programme metadata/progress rollover without user interaction. Also reset clock on channel change.
Implemented pinch-to-zoom in GuideGrid using PinchGestureHandler. Horizontal time scale now adjusts with two-finger gesture and preserves center timeline position during zoom.
Reworked programme modal touch hierarchy to avoid backdrop gesture conflicts, enabled nested vertical scrolling, and made long descriptions reliably scrollable.
Updated previously-shown badge copy from 'Rerun' to clearer 'Previously Aired'.

Implemented background playback and lock-screen/PiP control plumbing for native player path: playInBackground/playWhenInactive, enterPictureInPictureOnLeave, showNotificationControls, source metadata, and iOS UIBackgroundModes audio + Android notification permission in app config.

Current implementation routes HLS streams through native player first to expose PiP/Now Playing/AirPlay controls, with VLC fallback retained for TS reliability. Remaining gap is dedicated tvOS/watch app surface, which is a separate product-scope effort beyond transport controls in iOS Now Playing.

payload.description: Guide screen pinch zoom throws runtime error because PinchGestureHandler is mounted outside GestureHandlerRootView. Wrap root layout to satisfy gesture-handler requirements.
payload.title: Guide pinch crash: missing GestureHandlerRootView at app root

payload.body: Fixed by wrapping app root in GestureHandlerRootView in app/_layout.tsx, making PinchGestureHandler valid at runtime.

payload.description: Pinch zoom works but feedback is too subtle and channel rail consumes too much width in portrait, making guide changes hard to perceive.
payload.title: Guide pinch responsiveness is too subtle

payload.body: Updated GuideGrid pinch behavior to continuous scaling during gesture (onGestureEvent), preserved center timeline during zoom, and reduced channel rail width responsively on narrow screens so programme grid remains primary.

payload.description: Guide viewport shows large empty timeline area before programme cells, making portrait and landscape feel unusable. Reduce left dead-space and anchor initial view to content.
payload.title: Guide wasted timeline dead-space in portrait

payload.body: Adjusted grid start window from now-minus-30 to current half-hour and changed initial horizontal anchor to first actual programme cell (with minimal left margin), reducing dead timeline space in portrait and landscape.

payload.description: Guide initial horizontal anchor can be biased by off-screen rows, leaving visible top rows with large empty timeline space.
payload.title: Guide initial anchor uses off-screen rows

payload.body: Adjusted guide viewport anchoring to only consider top visible channels and moved grid start to near-now context, reducing large empty left-side timeline regions in both portrait and landscape.
